mainEntity.name: How much does a comprehensive GEO strategy cost for a business with multiple locations?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a comprehensive GEO strategy for a multi-location business varies significantly depending on several factors, including the number of locations, the competitiveness of the markets, the current state of your online presence, and the scope of services required. Services can range from basic Google Business Profile optimization to extensive local content creation, citation building, and review management across dozens or hundreds of locations. We offer customized proposals after assessing your specific needs and goals, providing a transparent breakdown of investment based on the desired level of support and expected outcomes.
acceptedAnswer.description: The cost of a comprehensive GEO strategy for multi-location businesses varies based on location count, market competitiveness, current online presence, and service scope; customized proposals are provided.
